title: Normalized mixed tensor comparison before completion
statement: Let l be prime and E,F finite extensions of Q_l with embedding i:E→F. Let g:X→Y be between noetherian finite-dimensional l-invertible schemes, with normalized continuous realizations at X and Y, Along comparisons agE and agF, and FieldChange comparisons bX and bY [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data]. There exist the coefficient equality, ordinary isomorphism, all-scalar ordinary section equation, termwise complex isomorphism with component equation, and ambient derived isomorphism with its flat-term K-flat normalized computation equation, exactly the fields of Mixed preceding raw. The AmbientMixed record asserts no raw isomorphism, completion equation or raw realization compatibility.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(2), Remark 6.8.15; Stacks Tags 0D6D, 0A0E and 0A0G. Expansion of the normalized comparison argument.

proof.text: Choose normalized raw module realizations and their normalized pullback comparison records using the two declared existence theorems. In the mixed case also choose the scalar comparison records. Pointwise continuous-function normalization identifies their coefficient maps with the supplied Along and FieldChange coefficient maps. Transpose the coefficient maps through the inverse-image adjunction. Precomposition of continuous functions and postcomposition by i commute, giving the coefficient square.

The mixed ordinary scalar comparison in rational-realization-scalar-coherence is balanced tensor multiplication. Remove identity scalar extension by the inverse-image scalar-unit normalization. Transport the comparison across this ordinary isomorphism. Its formula extends from unit generators to every coefficient by scalar linearity and balancing; sheafification gives equality on the actual module sheaves.

Apply the transported comparison degreewise. The supplied normalized counits identify the derived computations with the old counits followed by the degreewise identity-scalar removal. Substitute in the old mixed computation equation and cancel those comparison maps. On flat-term K-flat resolutions this gives the required normalized equation, which descends to the ambient derived isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: H8 expansion of BS Remark 6.8.15 into ambient tensor calculations and integral unit cancellation.

theorem continuousAmbientMixedCoherence (i : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] F)
    {X Y : Base.{u} l} (g : X.scheme ⟶ Y.scheme)
    (aXE : At l E X) (aYE : At l E Y) (aXF : At l F X) (aYF : At l F Y)

    (bX : FieldChange l E F i X aXE aXF) (bY : FieldChange l E F i Y aYE aYF) :
    Nonempty (AmbientMixed l E F i g aXE aYE aXF aYF agE agF bX bY)
